note: Authored release notes — the single source of truth for the in-app changelog (see WORKFLOW.md). Because dev -> main is squash-merged, this is maintained by hand, not generated from git. Add lines to `unreleased` as you work on dev; at release, move them into a new `releases` entry with a SemVer version and date. Keep newest release first.

changes.text: Combat panel is now live: Initiative (Dexterity step, less armour), Knockdown (Strength step), and Karma (maximum from race and Circle), each rollable.
Tabbed character sheet: Overview, Disciplines, Spells, Gear, and Notes.
Overview dashboard — attributes, defences, armour, health, movement, and combat at a glance.
Special Features panel showing racial abilities and their linked traits.
Exploding-dice roller with a result modal for rollable stats.
Rules engine: Physical, Mystic, and Social Defence derived from attributes plus racial and discipline effects.
Light and dark theme toggle, with the choice remembered.
Character details modal with portrait, background, and vitals.
Self-hosted the UI framework so the app loads reliably and works offline.
